Score AI consulting firms from the same RFP

Send each firm one scenario and one evidence request. Use the answers to choose which team deserves a paid discovery engagement.

Worked example

Suppose two firms propose a support-ticket triage pilot. One offers a polished demo. The other sends a sample acceptance test. Give both the same anonymized tickets, a list of permitted actions and the name of the person who will approve the pilot. Ask each to walk through one misrouted ticket.

Worksheet
DecisionEvidence to request
Who will do the work?Name the delivery lead and the engineer who will handle integration. Ask them to attend the review and identify their weekly availability.
Can the buyer test the outcome?Request a sample scorecard with expected routing, actual routing and the cost of escalation. Ask who decides disputed labels.
What does the quote buy?Mark each item as included, optional or supplied by the buyer. Include data cleanup, access setup, monitoring and post-launch support.
Can another team take over?Request a sample handover and a reference who has operated a delivered system. Ask the reference about the first change their own team made.

Keep a decision record

Have each reviewer mark every row as demonstrated, promised or unanswered before the group meets. Attach the file or reference behind each mark. If the preferred firm wins on a promise, put that deliverable and its acceptance test in the statement of work.
